svg.title: Figure 07 · Premium and volatility quote intervals
svg.desc: Synthetic one-year calls; premium half-spread 0.04. IV curves use a first-order vega conversion, not an exact bound inversion. Every premium bid in the shown range remains above its intrinsic lower bound.
